title: Northbeam Returns and Restocking: Measuring Collection Notice against the Waiting a Return Has Already Done
content:
The waiting the return has already done is then measured against the notice so counted. Where the return has been standing authorised for longer than the waiting notice multiple of the schedule's collection lead days and two or more collection bookings stand on it, the notice is halved and rounded down to a whole day. Where the return has been standing authorised for longer than that multiple of the schedule's collection lead days and fewer than two collection bookings stand on it, a quarter is taken off the notice and the result is rounded down to a whole day. Where the return has been standing authorised for no longer than that multiple of the schedule's collection lead days, the notice stands as counted.

The waiting notice multiple is 2. The count of collection bookings that divides the first two measurements is 2.

## The figure the waiting is measured against

The notice in question is the notice on which a Northbeam Returns and Restocking collection is agreed.

The days the return has been standing authorised are the days from the day the return was authorised to today. They are compared with twice the collection lead days published against the return schedule the line falls under.

| Return schedule | Collection lead days | Twice that figure |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Fifteen Day Return | 3 | 6 |
| Member Extended Thirty Day Return | 2 | 4 |
| Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return | 2 | 4 |
| Activated Wireless Device Return | 0 | 0 |
| Open Box and Clearance Final Sale | 0 | 0 |
| Business Contract Return Schedule | 5 | 10 |

## The three measurements

| Days standing authorised | Collection bookings standing on the return | The notice |
| --- | --- | --- |
| longer than twice the schedule's collection lead days | 2 or more | halved, and rounded down to a whole day |
| longer than twice the schedule's collection lead days | fewer than 2 | a quarter taken off, and the result rounded down to a whole day |
| no longer than twice the schedule's collection lead days | any number | stands as counted |

## Boundary and rounding cases on hypothetical inputs

*A notice so counted of 9 days, on a schedule whose collection lead days are 2, the return standing authorised for 5 days, three collection bookings standing on it.* Five is longer than 4 and three is 2 or more: half of 9 is 4.5, rounded down to 4 days.

*The same notice and schedule, the return standing authorised for 5 days, one collection booking standing on it.* Five is longer than 4 and one is fewer than 2: three quarters of 9 is 6.75, rounded down to 6 days.

*The same notice and schedule, the return standing authorised for exactly 4 days.* Four is not longer than 4, so the notice stands as counted at 9 days, whatever the bookings on it.
